blurb: David Sacks is a Silicon Valley entrepreneur and venture capitalist best known as a founding PayPal executive (COO/product) and a member of the so-called PayPal Mafia. He founded Yammer, an enterprise social network acquired by Microsoft in 2012 for ~$1.2B, and later co-founded Craft Ventures, a VC firm focused on SaaS and crypto. He is a co-host of the high-profile All-In Podcast alongside Chamath Palihapitiya, Jason Calacanis, and David Friedberg, and was appointed by President Trump as the White House AI & Crypto Czar in January 2025.
credibility_note: Sacks has a strong track record as an operator and early-stage investor. He holds a pronounced libertarian/conservative political outlook and publicly endorsed Trump ahead of the 2024 election, which colors his commentary on regulation, AI policy, and crypto. His dual role as a sitting government official and active podcast commentator is a noted conflict-of-interest concern raised by critics.

sources.title: David Sacks — Why I'm Backing President Trump (Reddit/AllIn)
